notes: L is the safety preimage of Y={0,+}^ω under the residual machine of F(x)=x^2. The prefixes 10^m are pairwise Myhill-Nerode inequivalent via residuals g_m(x)=3^{m+1}x^2+2x and words w_m=(-1)^{m+1}0, using pack((-1)^k)=-(3^k-1)/2 and the first k digits of 1-3^k. This is not Ahmed-Savchuk (unrestricted x^2 infinite-state) and not BTL-zero-output (zero-output lifting is a proper subset of L). Not a Collatz claim. Lean is deferred.
statement: For F(x)=x^2 and Y={0,+}^ω, the language of trit words whose residual output trits all lie in {0,+} is not regular; equivalently the 3-adic preimage is not sofic.
tested_range: exact distinguishing family through m<n≤6 and census m,r≤7 in tests/research/regular_output_preimages/test_triage.py
title: Safety preimage of x^2 under {0,+}^ω is not regular
